description: Protocol only. Write specs, freeze ACDD contracts, lint TDD evidence, check project state, run the reference demo and the offline acceptance tooling. One repo, no workers, no UI, no services.

components.role: the protocol itself: schemas, validators, templates, reference demo, checkers
components.why: the contracts profile is exactly this repository; nothing else is needed to author and verify a contract

env.name: ACCEPTANCE_MODE
env.note: docker or local for acceptance/cold_start.sh; default picks docker if usable

env.name: ACCEPTANCE_ACDD
env.note: require fails the run without an ACDD-capable bundlebees; auto reports the step UNRUN

env.name: WORKFLOW_REF
env.note: branch or tag the acceptance harness clones; defaults to main

env.name: BUNDLEBEES_REF
env.note: branch or tag the acceptance harness clones for bundlebees; defaults to main

ports: none: this profile starts no service; everything is files, schemas and short-lived checkers
auth_posture: no credentials needed for the reference demo, lint or checkers; the optional cold-start acceptance clones public repos and pip-installs pytest only; nothing reads or stores a key
cannot_do: cannot dispatch work to any worker (no execution layer present)
cannot run the real verify sandbox loop end to end without a bundlebees checkout (the acceptance harness fetches one itself)
cannot enforce a parked project: the project-state checker is advisory until an enforcing layer ships (docs/18)
cannot host boards, sessions or an activity view
